summary: Weekly Tuesday-evening unplugged bluegrass jam hosted by Pisgah Brewing Company in Black Mountain. This unit's MountainX listings ('Bluegrass Open Jam') describe the same day, venue, and format as the LiveMusicAsheville-sourced 'Black Mountain Bluegrass Jam unplugged' (unit 1414, covered separately as slug black-mountain-bluegrass-jam) - almost certainly the same real-world jam ingested from two different scraper sources under different listing names. It is a bring-your-instrument acoustic jam circle rather than a sign-up-and-perform open mic, which is the format more likely to sustain a returning core of players, but no independent evidence (Facebook group, named leader, membership language) confirms a fixed community beyond the venue-run event.

evidence.note: MountainX listing: 'Join us on Tuesday evenings for an acoustic adventure in bluegrass music. Open to all ages and skill levels, this is a fun and spontaneous gathering of musical talent.' No organizer name, membership language, or sign-up link; identical wording across all 5 listings in this unit.

Same venue (Pisgah Brewing Co., Black Mountain), same weekday (Tuesday), and same weekly cadence as unit 1414's 'Black Mountain Bluegrass Jam unplugged' from the LIVE_MUSIC_AVL source - strong indication these are the same jam under two scraper-source names, not two distinct groups.
LiveMusicAsheville describes it as hosted Tuesdays at 6pm in the taproom, moving to the patio in nicer weather, bring-your-instrument, all levels welcome - a jam-circle format.

Explore Asheville's roundup of Asheville-area bluegrass jams lists this as 'the unplugged, all-levels Black Mountain Bluegrass Jam' at Pisgah Brewing, part of a broader recognized local bluegrass jam circuit, but gives no detail on named regulars or an organizing body separate from the venue.
No dedicated Facebook group, Meetup page, or independent website for this specific jam was found; only the venue's own event listings and aggregator calendar pages.
